packageRules.description: Kubernetes libraries move together and a partial bump does not build. One PR or none.
Likewise OpenTelemetry: the SDK, the API and the exporters share a release train.
Everything else, batched weekly. A separate PR per Go module is noise nobody reads.
A Go major is an API break; it needs a human, not a merge queue.
The toolchain is pinned in flake.nix as well, so a go.mod bump alone would leave the two disagreeing and CI building a different Go from the dev shell.
prBodyNotes: `flake.nix` pins the Go used by CI and the dev shell. Bumping `go.mod` without it leaves them disagreeing.
